content.value_statement: Manual PDF extraction, editing, and form filling can require several specialized tools. This skill provides practical local workflows for common PDF tasks.
actual_capabilities: Extracts text and tables with pypdf and pdfplumber workflows.
Creates single-page and multi-page PDFs with ReportLab examples.
Merges, splits, rotates, crops, watermarks, and encrypts PDF files.
Inspects fillable form fields and writes validated field values.
Adds text annotations to non-fillable forms using calculated bounding boxes.
Renders PDF pages as images and documents OCR and image extraction workflows.
limitations: Third-party Python packages and command-line utilities must be installed separately.
OCR accuracy depends on scan quality, language support, and local Tesseract configuration.
Output paths can overwrite existing files because the scripts do not request confirmation.
The referenced scientific schematic generator is not included in this skill package.

use_cases.title: Extract Research Tables
use_cases.description: Convert article tables and page text into structured material for later analysis.

use_cases.title: Complete Repeated Forms
use_cases.description: Inspect form fields, validate supplied values, and produce completed PDF copies.

use_cases.title: Automate Document Assembly
use_cases.description: Combine, split, rotate, watermark, or encrypt PDFs within a local processing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract readable text from [input PDF]. Preserve page boundaries and save the result to [output file].

prompt_templates.title: Combine Selected Documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [PDF files] in this order: [order]. Save as [output PDF] and report the final page count.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect fillable fields in [input PDF]. Map [provided values], validate every field, and create [output PDF] without changing the original.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Process every PDF in [input directory]. Perform [operations], preserve source files, log failures, and place outputs in [output directory].

output_examples.input: Extract text from quarterly-report.pdf while preserving page boundaries.
output_examples.output: Created quarterly-report.txt with page separators. Processed 24 pages and reported two pages without extractable text.

output_examples.input: Merge cover.pdf, report.pdf, and appendix.pdf in that order.
output_examples.output: Created complete-report.pdf with 38 pages. The three source files were not modified.

output_examples.input: Fill the supplied enrollment form and validate all field choices.
output: No unsupported field choices were found.

best_practices: Keep source PDFs unchanged and write results to a separate output directory.
Visually inspect rendered pages after form filling, rotation, watermarking, or OCR.
Validate page counts, field identifiers, and output filenames before batch processing.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite the only copy of an important document.
Do not assume scanned pages contain extractable text without testing OCR.
Do not remove passwords or alter documents without authorization.

faq.question: Can this skill extract text from scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents an OCR workflow using pdf2image and Tesseract, which must be installed locally.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides pdfplumber examples for table extraction and optional conversion into pandas data frames.

faq.question: Can it fill existing form fields?
faq.answer: Yes. Included scripts inspect field metadata, validate values, and write a completed PDF.

faq.question: Can it fill non-fillable forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can place text annotations using bounding boxes, but visual validation is required.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No runtime network request is implemented. Required libraries and utilities may need separate installation.

faq.question: Will it preserve the original PDF?
faq.answer: The workflows use separate output filenames. Users should still verify paths because existing output files can be overwritten.
